text:
jamie: heads up — main pipeline went red right after my PR merged (PR #4321). smoke/gpu step failed on kvalloc, stacktrace in logs.
deploy-bot: Pipeline run 1722223333 - STATUS: FAILURE - failed step: smoke-test-gpu (shard-3)
jamie: can someone grab this? i can revert if it's definitely my change but want a quick confirm.
mira: i'm looking now, pinging @sam who owns the smoke runner.
sam: on it, starting a rerun for the same commit. will try `./ci/retry_pipeline --id 1722223333`
sam: rerun started — if it flakes same shard we should bisect.
carla: nothing else merged in the last 10m besides jamie's PR FYI.
mira: quick glance at logs: allocator OOM, error: `kv_alloc failed: out_of_memory` at 0x7f... stack shows `serve::kv::alloc`
sam: hmm shard-3 consistently failing on allocation. rerun shows same failure.
jamie: weird — my change touched routing for small-batch paths, not allocator.
mira: could be increased peak mem pattern exposing a latent bug. i'll kick off a local repro with the same config.
sam: filing a bisect job now, link: https://ci.internal/bisect/1722223333
sam: tagging eng-infra owner @sam for follow-up, and @jamie for revert decision.
jamie: thanks — i'll stand by to open a revert if bisect points at my commit.
carla: +1 on quick revert if it short-circuits rollout.
mira: local repro started, attaching small log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T22:45:12Z] ERROR kv_alloc: requested 2048MB, available 0MB
[2026-03-18T22:45:12Z] trace: serve::kv::alloc -> allocator::evict -> oom
```
sam: plan: 1) pause canary on shard-3, 2) run bisect job, 3) revert if bisect implicates jamie's commit. will update status in the bisect link.
jamie: ok i'll prepare a revert PR ready to merge if you call it. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks, grabbing eyeballs now.
mira: will post back with repro outcome in this thread.
jamie: appreciate it — keeping traffic low until we have resolution.
